verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents an async crawler (AsyncWebCrawler with await arun), parallel crawling, and multi-URL batches with per-pattern strategies. It also documents supporting reliability pieces: automatic retry and a browser pool. However, the evidence shows only a single-URL async call, and nothing demonstrates batch scraping at the scale of thousands of URLs. missing for 10: an explicit batch/many-URL async API example, documented concurrency/rate-limit controls for large batches, evidence of thousands-of-URL scale, independent hands-on corroboration of large batch runs

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously

citations.quote: async with AsyncWebCrawler() as crawler: result = await crawler.arun(url="https://crawl4ai.com")
